title: Polynomials
subtitle: Understanding algebraic expressions and their properties
subject: Mathematics
author: Shine Academy EduOS
learning_outcomes: Identify polynomials in one variable and their degrees.
Factorize polynomials using the Factor Theorem.
Use algebraic identities to solve expressions.

ai_context.learning_goal: To build a strong foundation in polynomial operations, factorization, and algebraic identities.
common_misconceptions: Confusing the degree of a polynomial with the number of terms.
Misunderstanding the difference between a zero of a polynomial and the constant term.
ai_context.tutor_hint: Always remind students to check the powers of variables to ensure they are non-negative integers before classifying an expression as a polynomial.
